{{av}} '''Steel''' is an [[alloy]] of [[iron]] and [[flux]], smelted at a [[smelter]]. A dwarf must mine iron ore before any forging can begin; mining is therefore the first constraint on steel production. Once the ore is hauled to the smelter the forge consumes fuel at a steady rate, and forging a single bar takes one job.
Steel is used for weapons, armour, and the walls of a well-defended fortress. Building walls from steel is wasteful, but it is possible.
[[Category:Metals]] [[Category:Materials]]

'''Magma''' is molten rock. It powers a magma [[smelter]] and a magma [[forge]] without fuel, which is why so much of fortress design is about getting magma to where the forging happens.
Mining down to the magma sea is dangerous. A careless mine shaft floods, and the walls of the shaft will not save you. Many a fortress has drowned in its own mining project.
[[Category:Materials]]
'''Steel''' in the 2012 release. Superseded, kept so that a version-prefixed title resolves to its own namespace rather than to the current article. Mining and forging worked much the same way.
'''Steel''' in the Masterwork mod, where the forge chain gains extra reactions and mining yields additional ores. Walls built from mod metals behave normally.

'''Dwarf Therapist''' is an external utility for managing labours, including mining assignments. It does not change forging or walls in any way.
This namespace is not in NS_NAMES and must be skipped by the build.
